title: Steward: building a free D&D 2024 character companion with AI (six-screen demo)
author: daleyustin
selftext:
I'm Agustín, building Steward, a free, unofficial browser companion for creating and tracking one D&D 2024 character. It handles player-side bookkeeping during tabletop sessions: HP, resources, spells and inventory.



Try the alpha: [https://stewardrpg.com/app/](https://stewardrpg.com/app/)



I use Claude for coding and ChatGPT for research and auditing, with extensive AI assistance across development. I handle the design decisions and testing. One structural choice is keeping character options in data tables, with an engine that resolves them. The app is a single HTML file, with an engine regression harness and DOM-based UI checks alongside it.



The six real screenshots show character creation, premades as a quick start, damage, resources, spell slots and inventory. These are October 18 demo scenes using different characters; the app manages one at a time. The illustrations inside the app were generated with AI.



If you were testing this, which state transition would you probe first: spending a resource, taking a rest, or restoring a backup? I'd appreciate concrete test ideas or confusing interactions you notice. Please use a test character.



The interface is in English and storage is local to your browser, so export a copy before clearing browser data. It's free to use without an account or subscription; the website has optional development support. Some options beyond SRD 5.2.1 remain under review. Thanks for taking a look!
